title: Lyceum Project Leaders Talk Corporate Funding and AI in Education
hook_text: Harvard debates AI and corporate cash.
script:
Harvard University leaders at the Lyceum Project just tackled corporate funding and AI in the classroom.
The group explores how private technology investments shape modern student learning and academic environments.
Speakers examined the balance needed to keep academic independence against growing corporate influence.
Panelists also weighed how generative tools alter traditional philosophy instruction and research methods.
Would you want corporate money dictating the tools inside your university classes?
